# Origin Tours & Travels

> Hyderabad-based, IATA-accredited travel agency (established 2010) specialising in
> Umrah & Hajj pilgrimage packages, domestic and international holiday tours, visa
> stamping for 50+ countries, and certificate attestation. Office in Masab Tank,
> Hyderabad; serves travellers across Telangana and India.

## Services

- [Umrah Packages](https://origintoursandtravels.com/umrah): Economy to premium Umrah packages from Hyderabad for the 2026 season. Price range ₹75,000–₹1,50,000 per person (varies by hotel category, distance from Masjid al-Haram, and room occupancy). Includes Umrah visa, return flights, Makkah and Madinah hotels, transfers, and Ziyarat.
- [Hajj Packages](https://origintoursandtravels.com/hajj): Guided Hajj 2026 packages with visa, return flights, Makkah and Madinah accommodation, and an experienced Aalim guide.
- [Visa Services](https://origintoursandtravels.com/visas): Tourist and business visa processing and stamping. Typical processing — UAE 2–3 working days, Schengen 15–20 working days. Coverage includes UAE, UK, USA, Schengen, Vietnam, Uzbekistan, and Saudi Arabia.
- [Certificate Attestation](https://origintoursandtravels.com/attestations): HRD, MEA, embassy, and MOFA attestation plus apostille for educational, personal, and commercial documents. Turnaround typically 2–5 working days for standard documents.
- [Holiday Tours](https://origintoursandtravels.com/tours): Domestic and international group and customised holiday packages departing from Hyderabad.
- [Air Ticketing](https://origintoursandtravels.com/air-ticketing): Domestic and international flight bookings.
- [Hotel Booking](https://origintoursandtravels.com/hotel-booking) and [Transport](https://origintoursandtravels.com/transport).
